defaultDesc:
Choose which Psych Engine version's mod API/UI to emulate.
Auto keeps the previous behavior (0.6.3, or 0.7.3 if the old compatibility toggle was on).
Note-related callbacks (onSpawnNote, goodNoteHit, note splash...) adapt automatically.
If selected, Hscript will handle errors the same way as LUA, which may have some impact on Hscript.

If a Lua/HScript keeps throwing errors every frame, ignore that script
once it reaches the error limit instead of spamming errors non-stop.
How many consecutive errors a script may throw before it is ignored.
Change the font of lua (if lua is not set)
If checked, the new charting state will be used instead of the old one
If checked, chart editors will automatically save backups and create autosave data (also when entering Playtest). Unchecked by default so your chart is NEVER saved without you pressing Save manually.
Press ENTER to open/close the debug console window. Shows real-time colored trace output.
Set the minimum trace level displayed in console. DEBUG shows all, ERROR only shows errors.
